name: booksim2
patches: vendored as full source tree replacing upstream checkout (internal branch updated-booksim)
local_modifications: veritx_ext.cpp: snake_mesh registration commented out (flit mcast support now exists since 2026-09-04 merge; snake routing still not ported onto it)
snakeroute.{cpp,hpp} excluded from the tree (Flit::mcast is present now; re-enabling means porting snake routing to the mcast-fork model)

networks/gec.cpp + gec.hpp + routefunc.cpp + booksim_config.cpp: origin/main GEC/hybrid work merged 2026-09-04 (mesh / hybrid mesh+MECS / express / MECS modes, hybrid_gec routing, VC-disjointness checks)
stats.cpp: log-linear histogram binning for wide dynamic range (73c to 13M)
stats.cpp: Percentile(p) method for exact p50/p95/p99 computation
trafficmanager.cpp: drain remaining packets even when simulation unstable

tracetrafficmanager.{cpp,hpp} (resolve/mr12): CSV + veritx-format trace replay via sim_type=trace (TraceFileTrafficPattern pending-in-pattern design), per-packet CSV log, honest _all_latencies feed (arrival-request_time)

trafficmanager.{cpp,hpp} (resolve/mr12): _OnPacketGenerated hook placed after VeritX self-loop early-return; pid->request_time honest-baseline map (erase-on-consume, per-Run clear, ctime fallback for synthetic traffic)
main.cpp (resolve/mr12): exit-code fix, success exits 0 (was inverted: every clean run exited 255)
examples (resolve/mr12): 8 trace-mode configs + mesh88_lat_transpose (preserved transpose demo) + workload.yaml/workload72.yaml generators inputs
known_gaps: GEC wire-length pricing: NOT ported. Since the 2026-09-04 merge this gec.cpp is origin/main's full GEC work (mesh / hybrid mesh+MECS via hybrid=1 + routing_function=hybrid_gec / express p2p / MECS modes, with VC-disjointness checks), but every mode hardcodes 1-cycle channel latency and REFUSES use_noc_latency=1 (config error) rather than silently mis-pricing. The per-wire priced variant (express channels priced at Manhattan pitch under use_noc_latency=1) still lives only on branch alice-booksim-wirepriced. Until ported: any gec/hybrid_gec comparison must set use_noc_latency=0 on both sides.

snake_mesh / snakeroute: Flit::mcast support now exists (flit.hpp: mcast flag + mcast_copies fork list), but snake_mesh registration stays commented out in veritx_ext.cpp and snakeroute.{cpp,hpp} remain excluded -- porting snake routing onto the mcast-fork model is open TODO work.

NOTE(research-branches): t3 battle scripts that assume priced GEC (e.g. tracks/t3-topology/scripts/claim2_battles.py on exp-d-rtalloc-on-good) will hard-fail their gec leg until the pricing patch lands here.

container_image.description: Container image copies this source directly (no upstream clone)
container_image.note: Dockerfile was updated to COPY from third_party/ instead of cloning upstream, so container always has our modifications
